message.content:
Below is a quick‑start guide to the most popular “startup‑stat” APIs that are publicly documented (or at least have a public‑facing endpoint).  
I’ll cover the **Crunchbase Public API**, the **AngelList API**, and a few **free / low‑cost alternatives** that you can try out right away.  

---

## 1. Crunchbase Public API

Crunchbase is the industry standard for startup data (funding rounds, valuations, founders, etc.).  
The public API is REST‑style and requires an API key (you can sign up for a free tier).

| Endpoint | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `GET https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations` | List organizations (companies, nonprofits, etc.) | `https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations?user_key=YOUR_KEY&organization_types=company&page=1` |
| `GET https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations/{org_id}` | Get a single organization | `https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations/google?user_key=YOUR_KEY` |
| `GET https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations/{org_id}/funding_rounds` | Funding rounds for a company | `https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1/organizations/google/funding_rounds?user_key=YOUR_KEY` |

### Quick Python snippet

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_CRUNCHBASE_API_KEY"
BASE_URL = "https://api.crunchbase.com/v3.1"

def get_company(org_name):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/organizations/{org_name}"
    params = {"user_key": API_KEY}
    r = requests.get(url, params=params)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()

print(get_company("google"))
```

> **Tip:** The free tier gives you ~200 requests/day. For higher volume, upgrade to a paid plan.

---

## 2. AngelList API

AngelList offers a GraphQL API (recommended) and a legacy REST API.  
You’ll need an OAuth token (you can generate one in your AngelList account settings).

| Endpoint | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `GET https://api.angel.co/1/companies` | List companies | `https://api.angel.co/1/companies?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN` |
| `GET https://api.angel.co/1/companies/{id}` | Company details | `https://api.angel.co/1/companies/12345?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN` |
| `GET https://api.angel.co/1/companies/{id}/funding_rounds` | Funding rounds | `https://api.angel.co/1/companies/12345/funding_rounds?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN` |

### Quick Python snippet

```python
import requests

TOKEN = "YOUR_ANGELLIST_ACCESS_TOKEN"
BASE_URL = "https://api.angel.co/1"

def get_company(company_id):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/companies/{company_id}"
    params = {"access_token": TOKEN}
    r = requests.get(url, params=params)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()

print(get_company(12345))
```

> **Note:** AngelList’s free tier is generous but may throttle after a few thousand requests per day.

---

## 3. PitchBook API (Enterprise)

PitchBook is another premium source. It offers a REST API and a GraphQL endpoint.  
You’ll need a corporate subscription; there’s no public free tier.

| Endpoint | Description | Example |
|----------|-------------|---------|
| `GET https://api.pitchbook.com/v1/companies` | List companies | `https://api.pitchbook.com/v1/companies?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN` |
| `GET https://api.pitchbook.com/v1/companies/{id}` | Company details | `https://api.pitchbook.com/v1/companies/67890?access_token=YOUR_TOKEN` |

> **Tip:** PitchBook’s API returns richer data (valuation history, M&A activity, etc.) but requires a paid license.

---

## 4. Free / Low‑Cost Alternatives

| Service | API | Key Features | Pricing |
|---------|-----|--------------|---------|
| **CB Insights** | REST API (requires subscription) | Funding, exits, market trends | Enterprise |
| **Crunchbase GraphQL** | `https://api.crunchbase.com/graphql` | Flexible queries, pagination | Free tier (200 req/day) |
| **Startup API** | `https://api.startupapi.com/v1/startups` | Basic company info, funding, founders | Free tier (500 req/day) |
| **Open Data – Crunchbase** | `https://data.crunchbase.com/api/v1/organizations` | Bulk CSV downloads | Free (CSV) |
| **AngelList GraphQL** | `https://api.angel.co/graphql` | Flexible queries | Free tier |

### Example: Startup API (free tier)

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_STARTUPAPI_KEY"
BASE_URL = "https://api.startupapi.com/v1"

def list_startups():
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/startups"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"}
    r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()

print(list_startups())
```

> **Why use Startup API?** It aggregates data from Crunchbase, AngelList, and other sources, and offers a simple JSON interface with a generous free quota.

---

## 5. How to Choose

| Criteria | Crunchbase | AngelList | PitchBook | Startup API |
|----------|------------|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| **Data depth** | High (funding, valuation, org structure) | Medium (funding, founders) | Very high (valuation, M&A, comps) | Medium |
| **Ease of use** | REST + GraphQL | REST + GraphQL | REST + GraphQL | REST |
| **Free tier** | 200 req/day | 5k req/day | None | 500 req/day |
| **Auth** | API key | OAuth token | OAuth token | API key |
| **Best for** | Enterprise-grade analytics | Quick startup scouting | Deep financial analysis | Rapid prototyping |

---

## 6. Quick Checklist Before You Start

1. **Sign up** for an account on the chosen platform (Crunchbase, AngelList, etc.).
2. **Generate an API key / access token** in your account settings.
3. **Read the rate limits** and plan accordingly.
4. **Test the endpoint** with a simple `curl` or Postman request to confirm you’re getting data.
5. **Implement pagination** (most APIs return paginated results; look for `next_page` or `page` parameters).
6. **Cache responses** if you’re making repeated calls to the same data.

---

### Final Thought

If you’re building a product that needs startup data, start with the **Crunchbase Public API** (free tier) or the **Startup API** (free tier). Both give you solid coverage of company profiles, funding rounds, and founders. If you need deeper financial metrics or enterprise‑grade data, consider upgrading to Crunchbase Pro, PitchBook, or CB Insights.

Happy coding! 🚀
